title: Adult Mouse Pancreas Cell Dissociation on Ice
author: Andrew Potter
materials: Dissect pancreas and place in ice-cold PBS.

steps.title: Mince pancreas tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Mince the pancreas tissue on a petri dish placed on ice for 2 minutes until a fine paste is obtained.

steps.title: Weigh tissue and add collagenase
steps.instruction: Weigh out 18 mg of the minced tissue and transfer it to a tube containing 1 mL Type 4 collagenase enzyme mix.

steps.title: Incubate and shake vigorously
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice, shaking vigorously every 30 seconds for the first 2 minutes to resuspend the tissue.

steps.title: Begin and continue triturating
steps.instruction: At the 2‑minute mark, begin triturating the suspension 10 times per minute and continue triturating on ice for a total of 20 minutes.

steps.title: Let tissue chunks settle
steps.instruction: After the 20‑minute incubation, allow the tissue chunks to settle on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Collect supernatant onto filter
steps.instruction: Pipette the top 75 % (approximately 750 µL) of the supernatant, which contains released cells, onto a 30 µm filter placed in a 50 mL conical tube, keeping everything on ice.

steps.title: Rinse filter with PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA. Save both the filter and the flow‑through for the next steps.

steps.title: Add collagenase to residual chunks
steps.instruction: To the residual tissue chunks remaining on the filter, add an additional 1 mL Type 4 collagenase enzyme mix.

steps.title: Continue triturating for additional time
steps.instruction: Continue triturating on ice 10 times per minute for an additional 30 minutes (total digestion time 50 minutes).

steps.title: Filter remaining suspension and rinse
steps.instruction: Triturate the entire volume and pass it through the same 30 µm filter in the 50 mL conical tube, then rinse the filter with another 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Centrifuge flow-through
steps.instruction: Transfer the flow‑through to a 15 mL conical tube and spin at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 100 µL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL RBC lysis buffer, triturate 20 times, and incubate on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Dilute lysis buffer with PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA to dilute the RBC lysis buffer.

steps.title: Second centrifugation and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Spin the suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension and cell counting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 100 µL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA, assess viability and yield with a hemocytometer using trypan blue, and adjust the cell concentration to 1,000 cells/µL for Chromium or Drop‑Seq workflows.
